rows.text: "Our sales growth accelerated in the third quarter, buoyed by demand from national customers, our digital platform and political spend," Lamar chief executive Sean Reilly said. "With those results in hand and a strong start to the fourth quarter, we are raising our guidance for full-year AFFO per diluted share to a range of $8.87 to $8.97."
We now expect diluted earnings per share for fiscal year 2026 to be between $6.01 and $6.04, with diluted AFFO per share between $8.87 and $8.97.
